text:
maya: FYI staging perf spike after deploying checkpoint r3. Token/sec for chat-sync routes down ~30–40%. Saw increased tail latency and more kernel fallbacks.

sam: Which deploy? commit/PR?

maya: last night's release from main -> checkout 2026-03-17T02:15Z, PR #8421 (checkpoint onboarding). Repro locally on our small cluster: tokens/sec drop with kv-heavy prompts.

jon-ops: CI perf job failed too: https://ci.redwood/.../perf/987

elaine: can you paste a flame or profiler output?

maya: pasted profiler snapshot below — note `generic_gemm` activity and a spike in `kv_cache_miss` metric
```
flame: top:
- generic_gemm: 48%
- attention_kv_lookup: 22% (misses++ )
- softmax: 8%
- memcopy: 6%
```

sam: interesting. Kernel selection moved to generic path for a bunch of seq lengths.

ryan: I think tokenizer changed: special token mapping now expands `<|pad|>` to two bytes? That can shift tokenization length distribution.

maya: confirmed — new checkpoint's tokenizer proto added an extra sentinel for eos. Average input token count up 12% on our test prompts.

jon-ops: that explains fallback to less-optimized kernels and higher KV cache churn. More cache entries => lower hit rate.

elaine: can we bisect to the onboarding PRs? try toggling tokenizer to old mapping in runtime to repro.

sam: bisect steps:
1) revert PR #8421 on staging
2) run perf job `./scripts/run_perf.sh --suite=kv-heavy --iters=200`
3) check `tokens/sec` and `kv_cache_hit_rate`

maya: I ran step 1 locally — revert brings tokens/sec back to baseline. kv_hit_rate +18%.

ryan: created quick fix PR #8499 to coerce tokenizer special token mapping during model load as a stopgap. Adds config flag `tokenizer.force_compat=true`.

elaine: Good. We should also improve kernel selection rule to prefer optimized matmul when seq len within 2x expected.

sam: agree. Filing runtime change: issue #1302. For rollout we should block until patch lands or revert onboarding.

maya: raising rollout-blocker in release channel. tagging @eng-sre and @product.

ci-bot: perf job queued: job 12345

jon-ops: after PR #8499 apply on staging, perf job shows tokens/sec restored and no generic_gemm spike. rolling patch.

maya: thanks. follow-up: add tokenizer integration test to onboarding CI to prevent drift.

elaine: will add a eval asserting token length distribution delta < 5% vs model's reference.

maya: closing loop. thx everyone :thumbsup:
